deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold.  Deal has been booked/capped in Dealertrack.

finance_deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold through financing.

aftermarket_deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold with aftermarket parts installed.

acp_tw_deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold with Allstate Complete Protection or Tire and Wheel Protection.

acp_tw_gross.description: The gross value of Allstate Complete Protection and Tire and Wheel Protection products.

vsc_deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold with Allstate Complete Platinum Protection or Ally Protection.

vsc_gross.description: The gross value of Allstate Complete Platinum Protection and Ally Protection products

gap_deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold with Gap insurance.

gap_gross.description: The gross value of Gap insurance products.

reserve_deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold with a finance or lease reserve.

reserve_gross.description: The gross value of finance or lease reserves.

sealant_deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold with a sealant product like Xzilon Evo Protection, Xzilon X7, or All Coat.

sealant_gross.description: The gross value of sealant products like Xzilon Evo Protection, Xzilon X7, or All Coat.

rust_deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold with rust protection like Final Coat.

rust_gross.description: The gross value of rust protection products like Final Coat.

accessory_deal_count.description: The number of vehicles sold with accessories installed.

accessory_gross.description: The gross value of any accessories installed.

total_product_deal_count.description: The total number of deals with any F&I product purchased (Allstate, Tire and Wheel, Ally, Gap, Xzilon, All Coat, or Final Coat).

total_product_gross.description: The total gross of all F&I products (Allstate, Tire and Wheel, Ally, Gap, Xzilon, All Coat, or Final Coat).

gpvr.description: The gross profit per vehicle retail using front end gross.

finance_penetration.description: The penetration of finance deals out of the total number of deals.

aftermarket_penetration.description: The penetration of aftermarket products out of the total number of deals.

acp_and_tw_penetration.description: The penetration of Allstate Complete Protection and Tire and Wheel Protection products out of the total number of deals

vsc_penetration.description: The penetration of Allstate Complete Platinum Protection and Ally Protection products out of the total number of deals.

gap_penetration.description: The penetration of Gap insurance out of the total number of deals.

sealant_penetration.description: The penetration of sealant products like Xzilon Evo Protection, Xzilon X7, or All Coat out of the total number of deals.

rust_penetration.description: The penetration of rust protection products like Final Coat out of the total number of deals.

accessory_penetration.description: The penetration of accessories installed out of the total number of deals.

total_product_penetration.description: The penetration of any F&I product out of the total number of deals.

reserve_penetration.description: The penetration of finance or lease reserve deals out of the total number of deals.

pvr_without_reserve.description: The gross profit per vehicle retail for all F&I products without a finance or lease reserve.

pvr_with_reserve.description: The gross profit per vehicle retail for all F&I products with a finance or lease reserve.

sale_date.description: The sale date for the vehicle deal in the primary model. This is the deal date from the opentrack API and records the sale date for the primary deal table.

vehicle_type_description.description:
The vehicle type recorded on the deal:
- N=New
 - U=Used

deal_type_description.description:
Description is determined by the following values:
- F=Finance
 - L=Lease
 - C=Cash
 - O=Outside Lien Holder (Like a cash deal to the dealership as there is only one payment, but the buyer secured their own financing)

front_end_gross.description:
House gross minus the total finance and insurance reserve.
- Calculated as: house_gross - total_f_and_i_reserve
 - Calculation for house_gross can be found in the house_gross column documentation.

sale_price.description:
The sellilng price of the vehicle. The OpenTrack response includes both a lease and retail price on a deal. The following logic is used to consolidate a single selling price in the primary table:
- For field `deal_type_description`:
 - 'Lease' = lease_price
 - Not 'Lease' (all other values) = retail_price

primary_salesperson_name.description: The name of the primary salesperson for the vehicle deal.

secondary_salesperson_name.description: The name of the secondary salesperson for the vehicle deal.

f_and_i_manager_name.description: The name of the F&I manager for the vehicle deal.

sale_manager_name.description: The name of the sale manager for the vehicle deal.
